title: Jimmy Fallon Teases Trump’s Efforts to Rekindle North Korea Bromance
summary: “Man, you know you’re depressed when you’re texting an old hookup from seven years ago,” Fallon said of the president and North Korea’s leader, Kim Jong-un.
